title: PPTX-Narrator: Automated Slide Narration Pipeline with Technical Term Normalization and ASR Verification
description: Open-source Python pipeline that turns PowerPoint presenter notes into voice-cloned narration (GPT-SoVITS or Qwen3-TTS), with technical-term and SI-unit normalization, ASR round-trip verification and automatic PPTX repackaging.
